remarks:
Welcome to this spacious 2,471 sq. ft. split-level home offering 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, ideally situated close to Lake Erie with deeded lake access.The second story was added in 2002, expanding the living space while retaining a practical layout. The first floor features an open floor plan centered around a beautiful fireplace, creating a comfortable gathering area. You’ll also find a first-floor bedroom and laundry for everyday convenience. Appliances are included. Exterior updates include newer vinyl siding and windows. A large two-car garage and plenty of yard space round out the property, giving room for outdoor activities and additional storage and workshop space.
This home is centrally located and along the shore of Lake Erie n Chautauqua County, offering convenient access to nearby communities and amenities:

Dunkirk — Enjoy public beaches at Point Gratiot and Wright Park, the historic Dunkirk Lighthouse, City Pier with boardwalk marketplace shops and dining, marinas, parks, fishing, and summer events like Music on the Pier.  

Westfield — Explore a walkable downtown with shops and dining, the Farmers and Artisans Market, Barcelona Harbor and Lighthouse on Lake Erie, and the surrounding Lake Erie Wine Country with local wineries and the Grape Discovery Center.  

Mayville — Access Chautauqua Lake for boating and recreation at Lakeside Park, ride the historic Chautauqua Belle steamboat, and enjoy proximity to outdoor trails and seasonal events.  

Chautauqua Institution — Experience lectures, concerts, performing arts, educational programs, and recreational opportunities on Chautauqua Lake during the summer season, with year-round access to the grounds and surrounding area.

The home itself offers a very functional and desireable floor plan with many practical updates and solid space for entertaining. 

This home is a solid opportunity for those seeking extra  room to spread out near Lake Erie and the region’s recreational and cultural offerings. Schedule a showing wirh an agent to see it for yourself. DELAYED SHOWINGS UNTIL 10/17/26 AND DELAYED NEGOTIATIONS UNTIL 10/17/26. OPEN HOUSE 10/17/2026.
